rooms_page_description: Everyone in a room shares one mod profile. Files and profile changes synchronize automatically; applying them to League remains your choice.
rooms_service_pending_description: Rooms use the secure central synchronization service. Authenticate with the room code and password to create or join.
rooms_join_title: Create or join an online room
rooms_join_description: Join with a code and password, or create a room from one of your profiles.
rooms_code_description: Use the code supplied by the room owner or enter a new one to create.
rooms_password_description: Password used to authenticate the room and secure credentials in the Windows Credential Vault.
rooms_profile_required: Choose the profile the room will share.
rooms_profile_description: Its enabled mods, order, and layers become the room's initial shared profile.
rooms_draft_ready_description: Connected successfully. The shared profile will now synchronize automatically on this device.
rooms_open_failed_title: Could not connect to the room
rooms_memberships_description: Rooms saved on this device. Leaving does not uninstall prepared mods or remove the local profile.
rooms_empty_description: Create or join an online room with a room code and password to view its synchronization state here.
rooms_leave_failed_title: Could not leave the local workspace
rooms_left_description: Prepared mods and profiles were kept unchanged.
rooms_auto_sync_ready_title: Shared profile is up to date
rooms_auto_sync_working_description: Downloading and verifying the room's latest mod files.
rooms_activity_idle_description: Nothing is being transferred. Real-time synchronization is listening for changes.
rooms_activity_checking_description: Comparing the local profile with the latest room revision.
rooms_activity_preparing_description: Reading and hashing the profile's mod files.
rooms_activity_uploading_description: The per-mod progress bars below show exactly what is being sent.
rooms_activity_publishing_description: Committing the manifest and notifying every connected member.
rooms_activity_downloading_description: Receiving and verifying the files from the latest shared revision.
rooms_activity_profile_description: Preparing disabled local mods and rebuilding the shared profile without applying it.
rooms_activity_complete_description: No transfer is running. Real-time monitoring remains active.
rooms_activity_failed_description: Nothing is stuck in the background. Use Refresh now to retry the synchronization.
rooms_apply_safety_note: Synchronization never applies mods to the game. Select this profile in Mods and use the normal Start/Play flow when you choose.
rooms_shared_profile_empty: This shared profile currently has no enabled mods.
rooms_sync_description: Downloads the room's shared mods, prepares them as disabled local mods, and keeps your non-active room profile up to date.
rooms_sync_done_description: The room's mods are downloaded, prepared, and your room profile is up to date.
rooms_sync_no_manifest: There is no accepted manifest on this device yet.
rooms_members_description: Connected room members and their synchronization states.
rooms_manifest_description: The mods currently shared by everyone in this room.
rooms_manifest_empty_description: This room does not have a shared profile yet. Choose one below to initialize it or recover an interrupted creation.
rooms_cache_description: Temporary verified files stay outside the mod library until you explicitly prepare a revision.
rooms_cache_pruned_description: Only unreferenced temporary files were removed.
rooms_cache_prune_failed_title: Could not prune the room cache
rooms_publish_description: Every member can update the shared profile; changes are synchronized automatically.
rooms_publish_done_description: The new revision is being synchronized to every member.
rooms_publish_failed_title: Could not send the profile to the room
rooms_publish_progress_preparing: Preparing and hashing the profile files...
rooms_publish_progress_uploading: Uploading mods to the room ({completed} of {total})...
rooms_publish_progress_failed: The room update could not be published.
rooms_workflow_description: One local click downloads, prepares, and keeps your room profile current. Creating or selecting a room never installs, enables, patches, or launches anything.
rooms_step_synchronized_ready: Accepted revision {revision} is verified in the isolated room cache.
rooms_step_synchronized_waiting: Wait for the room service to provide a complete, verified revision.
rooms_step_prepared_ready: Revision {revision} was imported as disabled local mods.
rooms_step_prepared_waiting: No accepted revision has been prepared in the local library.
rooms_step_profile_ready: A dedicated non-active room profile is ready for revision {revision}.
rooms_step_profile_waiting: Prepare the same accepted revision before creating its dedicated profile.
rooms_step_applied_selected: The room profile is currently selected. Start or Play remains a separate manual action.
rooms_step_applied_waiting: Choose the dedicated profile in Mods, then use the existing Start or Play flow when you decide to apply it.
rooms_workflow_unavailable: Preparation becomes available only after an accepted, synchronized revision exists.
